info.description:
Generated, not hand-written: `scripts/introspect_api.py` reads the org's own `$metadata` for what exists and how it is spelled, `scripts/enrich_catalogue.py` scrapes the published docs for what is required and what the option-set numbers mean, and `scripts/build_openapi.py` merges them. Do not edit this file — regenerate it.

`version` is the docs' own Change Log release, which is the only version number either source states.

post.summary: Run a CTC illustration (Bespoke XML v1.6)
post.description:
The illustration engine, a separate host from Dataverse. Takes CTC Bespoke XML v1.6 (CTC1) and answers XML. Unauthenticated: `nodb=true` plus an `<agent_name>` inside the document identifies the caller.

The content type is `text/xml`, NOT `application/xml` — the engine answers an HTML error page to the latter, with HTTP 200, so a client that trusts the status code reports a successful illustration that does not exist.

parameters.name: nodb
parameters.description: Credential-free mode; the caller is identified by <agent_name>.

200.description: An XML `<message>` document on success. Any other root element — or an HTML page — is an engine error despite the 200.

bearerAuth.description: Azure AD app-only token for the Dataverse resource. Does not apply to the CTC illustration host.
